_comment: When an Age comes apart at the bottom (design 5.3), and how fast. The only manifestation that ends
the Age: fissures open at the world floor, widen, and put whatever falls in back in the overworld.
Not drawn. `certain_from` is a threshold -- an index of 50 collapses the Age whatever else its draw
bought -- and the index past it buys `spread`, how fast the tear grows: the first step comes with the
threshold and each further one costs its price out of what is left over. `/age decay <name> unstable
<n>` is how that is reached for testing. 50 is a placeholder for the tuning pass.
